notes.title: Patch 1.1 - New Leaderboards and Options
notes.content:
This patch includes two new types of leaderboards!

Personal - You can check your own current global rank on all included game modes.
Friends - compare your own score to your friends only and have fun competing against each other.


New options in the settings menu!

Display Achievements - by unchecking this you won't get achievemenets displayed ingame, so that you can focus on the game, but you will still earn them!
Sound for Scoring - by unckecking this you won't hear a sound each time you score.
